successors.name: Sumerian city-states
successors.text: Umma, whose ensi Lugal-zage-si 'established his new capital' at Uruk and ruled Sumer from there

ledger.x: 2500 BCE: Umma a city-state under Kish's arbitration.
2450 BCE: war with Lagash over the Gu-edena.
2450 BCE: Umma pays tribute to Lagash.
2425 BCE: Umma throws off the tribute.
2400 BCE: Entemena of Lagash settles the frontier.
2340 BCE: Lugal-zage-si moves his capital to Uruk and rules Sumer.

wars.name: Lagash–Umma border conflict
wars.outcome: Ush defeated by Eannatum (Stele of the Vultures), boundary treaty with Enakalle, Umma tributary; Ur-Lumma and Il fought Entemena, who 'reported' the conflict c.

wars.name: Lugal-zage-si's conquest of Sumer
wars.outcome: Umma's ensi conquered Lagash, Uruk, Ur, Kish, Nippur and Larsa and ruled Sumer from Uruk until Sargon.

certainty.note: The Gu-edena boundary with Lagash is the one dated line (Mesilim's arbitration, Eannatum's treaty, Entemena's report); the rest is a city territory.
